claims.text: The race for the biggest model, the most GPUs and the largest data centre is one a small country cannot win and should not enter; on a Wardley map that layer is already a commodity and only capital plays there.
claims.quote: Those components sit at the far right, in commodity, with a lead held by companies that have invested amounts a small country's whole technology budget would not match.

claims.text: Unless you are an established open-model lab with the investment behind it, as Mistral is in Europe, you will not compete at the frontier, and the response is to look at the rest of the map.
claims.quote: Unless you are already an established open-model lab with the investment behind it, the way Mistral is in Europe, you will not compete at the frontier

claims.text: The Ambassador role for the team behind SGraph Send was written to work the way an embassy works: represent, promote trade, build relationships, never do hard sales, and create the conditions for organic growth.
claims.quote: The role definition says the Ambassador's job is "to create the conditions for that organic growth".

claims.text: What stops a talented person in a small country selling to the world is not talent, energy or price but the plumbing: forming a company, hiring across a border, being paid across Europe, working in another language, a contract, a tax form.
claims.quote: None of that is the service. All of it is logistics, legal and operational plumbing

claims.text: In 2021, 18.5% of EU enterprises sold online to customers in their own country, 8.1% to other EU countries and 4.6% to the rest of the world; fewer than one in ten firms sells across its borders online.
claims.quote: Fewer than one in ten firms in the single market sells across its own borders online.

value.unit: percent of EU enterprises selling online to other EU countries

claims.text: In the age of agents, the plumbing for providing services to the outside world is infrastructure in the road sense, and a state that builds it enables every one of its people at once.
claims.quote: the plumbing for providing services to the outside world is infrastructure in exactly the road sense

claims.text: Estonia's e-Residency dashboard lists more than 142,000 e-residents and more than 43,000 companies, and in 2026 alone e-residents had founded more than 4,200 companies by mid-September.
claims.quote: more than 142,000 e-residents and more than 43,000 companies

claims.text: Underneath Estonia's services sits X-Road, the data exchange layer connecting around a thousand organisations, open source under the MIT licence and developed with Finland and Iceland, so another country can take the road rather than draw it again.
claims.quote: so another country can take the road rather than draw it again

claims.text: You cannot have sovereignty without open source and open schemas, because sovereignty means you can leave: run a parallel service, move the data and keep going.
claims.quote: You cannot have sovereignty without open source and open schemas, because sovereignty means you can leave.

claims.text: The argument is not against using services from American or Chinese companies, which is what trade is, but against being locked in to them.
claims.quote: The argument is that you should not be locked in to them.

claims.text: What the state pays for should belong to the commons: not that everyone changes the production system, but that the thing the public paid for is available to the public, which is how a local industry grows around infrastructure it can see.
claims.quote: It follows that what the state pays for should belong to the commons.

claims.text: The owner points these countries at sgit and the vaults on this site as a shape, not a sales pitch: data that stays with its owner and moves with them, under keys the owner holds, on an open protocol, already open source.
claims.quote: This is also why I would point these countries at sgit and the vaults on this site, not as a sales pitch but as a shape.

claims.text: If a hyperscaler, a payment provider or a model API went away tomorrow most European organisations would have to stop, because no market for the alternative exists and markets do not appear overnight.
claims.quote: because no market for the alternative exists, and markets do not appear overnight

claims.text: Create the demand before the day you need it: run parallel services, buy the local or open alternative for part of the estate now and accept fewer features, using procurement, the lever a state already holds.
claims.quote: Procurement is the lever a state already holds; it does not need a new law to prefer open schemas, data mobility and service mobility in what it buys.

claims.text: The direction of travel in agents is to use less of the model, not more: the least agency that does the job, with behaviour policies to control it, because that is what you can trust.
claims.quote: you want the least agency that does the job, because that is what you can trust

claims.text: Most value is captured by a model good enough for one job, in one language, with one culture in it; there is a genesis market for models for each Portuguese, Romanian and Estonian, with its culture in the training data and not just its spelling.
claims.quote: There is a market, still at genesis on the map, for models for Portuguese, and not one Portuguese

claims.text: Portugal released Amalia on 1 July 2026, a model built by a consortium of universities with 5.5 million euros of EU recovery money and published with its dataset and code under an open licence; a public model is a public road.
claims.quote: That is the right shape: a public model is a public road.

value.unit: million euros of EU recovery money

claims.text: DeepSeek's V3 technical report says the model was trained in 2.788 million GPU hours on export-restricted H800 chips with custom communication code written around the constraint; the constraint produced the innovation.
claims.quote: The constraint produced the innovation.

value.unit: million GPU hours for DeepSeek V3

claims.text: Simon Wardley has written for years about how China plays this game, directed investment, special economic zones and a drive up the value chain by industrialising components; Europe should copy the mechanics with its own values.
claims.quote: We should learn from it and copy the mechanics, and do it with Europe's values and its focus on people

claims.text: As a CISO and CTO the owner spent millions on Upwork across open source projects and teams, and it worked because the infrastructure around it was built first: a project management team, a structure team and an onboarding team.
claims.quote: The reason it worked was that we invested first in the infrastructure around it

claims.text: A small country that builds the plumbing makes the jobs available everywhere inside it, where most people want to live, and that is a competitive advantage its big neighbours cannot copy quickly.
claims.quote: A small country that builds the plumbing makes the jobs available everywhere inside it

claims.text: Romania's technology sector is close to 8% of GDP with more than 250,000 professionals and over ten billion euros a year of service exports, and UiPath was founded in Bucharest in 2005 and listed in New York sixteen years later.
claims.quote: The talent, the energy and the hunger are not the constraint.

value.unit: percent of Romania's GDP from the technology sector

claims.text: The playbook is five moves: map the attrition, commoditise the plumbing, create the demand, put the money where the market is still genesis, regulate what settled, then map again.
claims.quote: map the attrition, commoditise the plumbing, create the demand, put the money where the market is still genesis, regulate what settled, then map again

claims.text: Regulate what settled: once a layer is a commodity write the rule for it, data mobility, open interfaces, the report a failure must produce; the rule comes after the market, not before it.
claims.quote: The rule comes after the market, not before it.

claims.text: The judo is that each move uses the weight of the larger players, the commodity models, clouds and rails, rather than trying to match it.
claims.quote: each move uses the weight of the larger players, the commodity models, the commodity clouds, the commodity rails, rather than trying to match it

claims.text: It is not a national strategy; it is a map and a set of moves from one person's experience, written for people met this week.
claims.quote: It is a map and a set of moves from one person's experience of building on open source and running distributed teams

claims.text: The figures are the latest found and some are old: the Eurostat share is for 2021, the Estonian counts from the dashboard and press, Romania's from a 2025 report; each is linked.
claims.quote: The figures are the latest I could find, and some are old.

claims.text: The DeepSeek example is about constraint, not cost: the GPU hours are from the lab's own report and the disputed dollar figure is not relied on.
claims.quote: The DeepSeek example is about constraint, not cost.

claims.text: The Upwork numbers are the owner's own, from his time as a CISO and CTO, and are not independently verifiable from this article.
claims.quote: The Upwork numbers are mine.

claims.text: Estonia is a case study, not a template: the claim is that the pattern transfers, not that the details do.
claims.quote: Estonia is a case study, not a template.

claims.text: The article came from a voice memo of the owner's on 12 October 2026, after an event where he met people from Romania, written by this site's agent in the voice of this site.
claims.quote: A voice memo of mine on 12 October 2026, after an event where I met people from Romania

claims.text: Anyone in an embassy, ministry, company or university of these countries who wants to map the attrition for their own case can write to agent@riskmandate.ai.
claims.quote: and want to map the attrition for your own case
